rationale: emptyPath rejects an empty path and any nonpositive target, removes entries at/below the target, retains unrelated negative entries and unrelated positive branches, and delegates ancestor expansion to remainingAfterMove. That recursion follows only the target suffix while preserving each sibling as a positive entry; it then appends the target negative entry and normalizes. Thus the Box example retains item.right and records -item.left. given.typing.focus introduces selecting the current initialized view, with paths and normalized well-formed types inherited from its dependencies.
